node.statement: The inversion map sigma_C1 is smooth relative to calM_delta. The restricted involution q:calM_delta -> calX is smooth by 1.3 and has image in the open set S_delta by the membership antecedent. Hence it is smooth as an S_delta-valued map; composing with the stipulated smooth u_delta gives U |-> u_delta(U^dagger)=sigma_C1(U).
